# sql.js 1.13.0

These unmodified runtime files come from the MIT-licensed `sql.js@1.13.0` npm package:

- `dist/sql-asm.js` (JavaScript compatibility engine when WebAssembly is unavailable or blocked)
- `dist/sql-wasm.js`
- `dist/sql-wasm.wasm`
- `LICENSE`

Package source: <https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js>

`manifest.json` records the exact npm package URL, npm integrity value and SHA-256 checksums. Installation verified the npm artifact integrity. Repository tests verify the retained runtime bytes. The website loads these files from its own origin, not from a CDN. The upstream sql.js license is retained in `LICENSE`. SQLite is in the public domain; see <https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html>.

To update, install a pinned version into a temporary directory with npm, verify package integrity, replace these files without modifying the upstream runtime, update `manifest.json`, and run the database, WASM and browser tests. Do not commit package caches or downloaded development dependencies.
